_doc: World events (systems/events.gd) and the cleaning streak. Every event points at cleaning, pressing or tending (docs/DECISIONS.md, side systems trimmed): Salvage Glint, Rain Shower, Rare Part Signal, Ledger Audit. Times are seconds of play. Event rewards scale with progress: cubes = max(min_cubes, income_rate * income_s, lifetime_earned * earned_frac), never above max_income_s of current income (the 3-minute rule; the floor min_cubes still holds when the rate is about nothing), so they stay a spike (about a minute or two of income) at every stage. schedule.every_s is the gap between the end of one event and the start of the next; events only start once min_hexes hexes have been cleaned (lifetime) and never in the middle of a menu, cinematic or rocket flight. [M3-19] Parts rewards are in the planet's Parts scale (a robot costs 10): 1 to 5 an event. [M3-13] Supply Drop, Robot Hiccup and Wildlife Visit were cut and the Requests board and the Collection's trinkets parked: their entries are in parked/side/events/ and parked/side/requests/, parked/side/trinkets/.

events.name: Salvage Glint
events.toast: Salvage Glint! A hex %s of you is glowing: its junk is worth 3x for two minutes.
events.hud: Junk from the glowing hex is worth 3x

events.name: Rain Shower
events.toast: Rain Shower. Real rain, the first in years. Your plants won't dry out while it lasts.
events.hud: Plants stay watered while it rains

events.name: Rare Part Signal
events.toast: Rare Part Signal! The detector caught a strong ping %s of you. Follow the violet beam.
events.hud: Dig up the part under the violet beam

events.name: Ledger Audit
events.toast: Ledger Audit! A friendly drone bets it can clear a patch of junk %s of you faster than you. Race it!
events.hud: Scoop more of the ringed junk than the drone

streak._doc: Points = pieces scooped in a row (Patch scoops up to ~8 a second). After grace_s without a scoop the points drain at drain_per_s, so a bale or a short walk barely dents it and only a long break resets it. The bale bonus uses the best tier reached while that bale was being filled.

event_salvage_surge: That hex is glowing. Readings say... valuable. Hurry.
Surge! The old buried cables light up when the junk shifts. Grab it while it's bright.
Look at that glow. Three times the value, two minutes. Go go go.
event_rain_shower: Is that... water? From the sky?
Rain. I'd forgotten the sound. Your plants hadn't.
Rain on clean ground. It smells like a memory.
event_rare_part_signal: Strong signal. Something old and well made.
That ping is Maker-grade. Follow the violet light.
A rare part, close. I can almost hear it.
event_ledger_audit: The Ledger wants to race. I told it you'd win.
Audit drone, friendly. It's very competitive now.
The Ledger says it's 'just a routine audit'. It's been practising.
event_won: Well done. That's going in my log.
streak_max: Max streak. The scoop is singing.
